submission.justification: S3 has the highest stat-only significance (4.1σ), but its validation-region data/MC disagreement is 35%. That is far above the 10% tolerance, because the jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled, so its background estimate is not robust. S1 (6%) and S2 (3%) are within tolerance. Of those two, S1 has the higher expected significance (3.4σ vs 2.6σ). I recommend S1 at the 50% efficiency working point. I did not run a working-point scan or include systematics in the significance, so 3.4σ is a statistical-only figure from 2025. The real significance will be lower once the ~6% background systematic is included.

requirements.evidence: S1 is the best among the robust options (3.4σ stat-only at 50% efficiency). I did not optimise the working point or include systematics.
